The b8ca51b compound-scope fix resolves a closed compound as soon as a redirection follows its closing word: the redirect branch calls resolveCompounds(false) at shell.ts:303.
b8ca51b added printfEscapes and started accepting `%b`, but its escape reader is not bash's.
The compound-scope rework (round 3, 587e67a) makes `isCommandStart` accept only RESERVED_WORDS/COMPOUND_CLOSERS.
`silenceInWrites` runs `checkContent` over the entire shell segment whenever that segment redirects to any file, or pipes into `tee`.
